newsitem.title: USA: Samsonite acquires factory in Slovakia.
newsitem.headline: Samsonite acquires factory in Slovakia.

text.p: Samsonite Corp said Monday it acquired the Samorin production facility in Slovakia to keep pace with its rapidly growing softside luggage business in Europe.

Luc Van Nevel, president of Samsonite International, said "The acquisition will lower the cost of meeting the growing demand for Samsonite softside luggage in Europe and avoid some of our exposure to fluctuations in U.S. currency."
The factory currently produces selected softside luggage products for Samsonite as well as automotive seating.
Samsonite did not release any specific date for the transaction to be completed or other details.
Samsonite manufactures and markets luggage under the Samsonite, American Tourister and Lark brands.
